statement: Every public image contains invented synthetic values only. No real account balances, API keys, account IDs, emails, private paths or personal usage are shown. Static PNGs are offline renders of the unchanged production WPF views; the GIFs are real screen captures of the packaged 1.7.0 preview window driven by the app's synthetic fixture. Both contain a permanent SYNTHETIC DEMO DATA marker.

capture.method: Real screen capture of the packaged QuotaMonitor v1.7.0 preview executable (--preview-v170, synthetic fixture)
capture.note: No real account, credential, balance or usage data; every asset carries a synthetic demo marker.
